title: KubeSplit
description: Split-learning run: progress, where client time goes, traffic, server contention and pod resources.

panels.title: Round
panels.description: Round the server is training now.

panels.title: Status
panels.description: Done once every round has closed.

panels.title: Clients
panels.description: Distinct clients that have joined this run.

panels.title: Accuracy
panels.description: Global model on the test set after the last closed round.

panels.title: Avg round
panels.description: Mean time from a round opening to closing, over this run.

panels.title: Timeouts
panels.description: Rounds closed by the timeout instead of a full quorum.

panels.title: Late updates
panels.description: Client updates discarded because their round had already closed.

panels.title: Rejoins
panels.description: Joins beyond each client's first: a client pod restarted mid-run.

panels.title: Test accuracy
panels.description: Global model on the test set, updated when each round closes.

panels.title: Training loss
panels.description: Server-side loss over the last closed round.

panels.title: Client time per batch
panels.description: Average over all clients. compute = the client's own forward/backward; blocked = waiting on the network and the server. Vanilla blocks on every gradient; decoupled only waits when the server applies backpressure.

panels.title: Client throughput
panels.description: Training samples per second, per client pod.

panels.title: Time waiting at the round barrier
panels.description: Share of each client's run spent idle, waiting for slower clients so the round can close. High values mean stragglers or uneven shards.

targets.expr: max by (name) (label_replace(sum by (pod) (kubesplit_client_idle_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", job="$release-client"}) / ((sum by (pod) (kubesplit_client_idle_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", job="$release-client"}) + sum by (pod) (kubesplit_client_round_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", job="$release-client"})) > 0), "name", "$1", "pod", ".*-(server|client-[0-9]+)(-.*)?"))

panels.title: Traffic by message kind
panels.description: Serialized bytes per second through the server. activations go up, gradients come back down (vanilla only), weights are the per-round model sync.

panels.title: Total transferred
panels.description: Bytes per message kind since the server started.

panels.title: Server time per batch
panels.description: compute = forward/backward through the shared top model; queued = waiting for another client's batch to release it. Queueing grows with clients.

panels.title: Server throughput
panels.description: Samples per second through the server's top model.

panels.title: Pods: CPU and memory against their limits
CPU used
panels.description: Share of each pod's CPU limit in use. The dashed line is the limit.

targets.expr: max by (name) (label_replace(sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$release-(server-.+|client-[0-9]+)", container!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$release-(server-.+|client-[0-9]+)", resource="cpu"}), "name", "$1", "pod", ".*-(server|client-[0-9]+)(-.*)?"))

panels.title: CPU throttled
panels.description: Share of CFS periods in which the pod hit its CPU limit and was paused. Sustained throttling means the limit, not the code, sets the speed.

targets.expr: max by (name) (label_replace(sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$release-(server-.+|client-[0-9]+)", container!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$release-(server-.+|client-[0-9]+)", container!=""}[$__rate_interval])) > 0), "name", "$1", "pod", ".*-(server|client-[0-9]+)(-.*)?"))

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Working set as a share of each pod's memory limit. At 100% the pod is OOM-killed.

targets.expr: max by (name) (label_replace(sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$release-(server-.+|client-[0-9]+)", container!=""}) / sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$release-(server-.+|client-[0-9]+)", resource="memory"}), "name", "$1", "pod", ".*-(server|client-[0-9]+)(-.*)?"))
